calculation.description: Residualizes each tradable asset's one-day return against the 60-day rolling beta to the cross-asset median return, then reverses the idiosyncratic shock and amplifies it when the five-day log US10Y/CN10Y spread move is unusually large. US10Y and CN10Y are tradable benchmark series used as conditioning inputs.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in 2020-2022 (+0.060465, 592 dates), 2023-2024 (+0.057006, 410 dates), and 2025-2027 (+0.027525, 491 dates); recent performance weakened but remains above gates.
